scheme_name: Delhi Pension Scheme To Women In Distress (Widow Pension)
other_conditions: Widow, divorced, separated, abandoned, deserted, or destitute woman
Minimum residence of 5 years in Delhi before application
Applicant must have an Aadhaar number
Applicant must have a single‑operated Aadhaar‑linked bank account with any bank in Delhi
Applicant must not be receiving any pension or financial assistance from Central, State, MCD, NDMC or any other governmental/local bodies
